name: MetalMania- Custom Metal Works Fabrication Shop
old_description: Handling all custom metal fabrication project with great precision and detail from beginning to end of the project.
about:
MetalMania Custom Metal Works operates from Brooklyn, New York. The shop opened in 2009, founded by a lead fabricator with over 30 years of industry experience that included 15 years reconstructing casinos in Macau, China. The business remains independently owned and has completed more than 2,500 custom projects across the five boroughs and beyond.

The company specializes in custom fabrication across six architectural metals: brass, bronze, copper, steel, 304/316 stainless steel, and zinc. Its capabilities cover welding (MIG, TIG, arc), laser and plasma cutting, bending and forming, and surface finishing such as polishing and powder coating. The shop also produces mixed-metal assemblies combining materials like brass with steel or copper with stainless steel.

MetalMania serves residential, commercial, and architectural clients. Homeowners commission custom stair railings, gates, and interior metalwork; architects and contractors specify facades, sunshades, and structural elements; businesses order branded fixtures, signage, and commercial railings. The team collaborates directly with designers and builders to integrate metalwork into broader project plans.

The firm distinguishes itself as one of the few New York City shops that fabricates in all six premium metals under one roof, leveraging the founder's Macau casino background for precision in complex geometries. It emphasizes a client-satisfaction record spanning its entire history.
